# Muhammed Abdulhadi
Full-stack developer based in Lagos, Nigeria. Open to junior full-stack roles and freelance collaborations.
Portfolio: https://mrglasswillbreak.vercel.app
## Selected work
- [TurnRight](https://mrglasswillbreak.vercel.app/projects/turnright): Independent LASU Ojo campus navigation PWA with offline maps, routing, and 3D buildings. Routes have not been field-verified.
- [RJWF](https://mrglasswillbreak.vercel.app/projects/rjwf): RemmyJ Wellness Foundation public website and private content studio.
- [Photography Portfolio](https://mrglasswillbreak.vercel.app/projects/photography-portfolio): Photography website with a gallery, CMS, and first-party analytics.
- [Fidarsi](https://mrglasswillbreak.vercel.app/projects/fidarsi): Corporate website and registration platform.
